data.one_liner: Handle gamepad and joystick input across multiple platforms
data.what_it_does: A Flutter plugin that enables applications to listen to gamepad inputs, track connection states of multiple controllers, and trigger controller vibration across Android, iOS, macOS, Windows, Linux, and Web.
use_when: Building a game or app that needs to support physical controllers and joysticks
Handling controller connection and disconnection events dynamically
Triggering haptic feedback or rumble effects on supported gamepads
avoid_when: Building standard touch-only mobile apps with no need for hardware peripheral input
Needing advanced features like adaptive triggers or arbitrary force feedback
strengths: Supports multiple platforms including Android, iOS, macOS, Windows, Linux, and Web
Provides normalized events for consistent button and axis mappings across controllers
weaknesses: Vendor ID and product ID are null on macOS and iOS because GCController does not expose them
Requires platform-specific boilerplate or configuration such as custom Android Activity implementation
Linux requires write access to the event device for rumble support
data.setup_notes: Requires platform-specific setup on Android (custom MainActivity implementing GamepadsCompatibleActivity) and ensuring Windows SDK / C++ desktop development is installed for Windows targets.
